
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(stars)
library(tmap)
```

# Research Question
How does potential exposure to wastewater discharge


```{r}
# Reading in data
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here(
  "data",
  "ejscreen",
  "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb"
))

# Filtering to Monterey County
monterey <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Monterey County"))
```

```{r}
# Filtering to columns to explore
mc <- monterey |>
  filter(ACSTOTPOP > 0) |>
  select(
    ID,
    ACSTOTPOP,
    AREALAND,
    P_PM25,
    P_OZONE,
    P_DSLPM,
    P_CANCER,
    P_RESP,
    P_RSEI_AIR,
    P_PTRAF,
    P_LDPNT,
    P_PNPL,
    P_PRMP,
    P_PTSDF,
    P_UST,
    P_PWDIS,
    DEMOGIDX_2,
    PEOPCOLORPCT,
    P_LINGISOPCT,
    P_LOWINCPCT
  )
```

```{r}
# Creating Scatterplots to analyze relationships

  data = mc,
  mapping = aes(
    x = DEMOGIDX_2,
    y = P_PWDIS

) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
# Narrowed down to environmental variable of interest
# Highest to lowest relationship:
# DEMOGIDX_2, PEOPCOLORPCT, P_LOWINCPCT
```
